title: Free school
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Friday. Gully's uncle's shack. Gully hears. 'You turned down free school.' 'It's not free.' 'It's free.' 'It costs four years.' Gully looks at the bait tank for four panels' worth of a beat.

panels.composition: The shack. GULLY, seventeen, at the bait tank with a net. WOOD on a crate. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a stocky teenager with a net at a bait tank in a shack, a thin teenager on a crate, a small dog

panels.composition: Gully looking into the tank. The crawlers. A long beat.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of a stocky teenager staring down into a bait tank, no words

panels.composition: Still looking. The net not moving.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, the same close-up of a teenager looking into a bait tank, unchanged, no words

panels.composition: Gully turning. Wood waiting for it.

balloons.text: Yeah. It is. That's what I'm telling you.
